name: fogprint
description: Analyse your Fog of World data with Claude: where you have been, what is left, and how to get there

plugins.name: fogprint
plugins.description: Reads Fog of World sync data (iCloud / Dropbox folder, zip or snapshot) and answers questions about it: visited and unvisited regions worldwide, coverage of railways, roads and streets, unexplored pockets near a place, snapshot diffs and maps.
